SEARCH
Module org.apache.jena.core
Package org.apache.jena.mem.store.indexed

Class EagerStoreStrategy

java.lang.Object
org.apache.jena.mem.store.indexed.EagerStoreStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
StoreStrategy
public class EagerStoreStrategy extends Object implements StoreStrategy
StoreStrategy that maintains a complete subject/predicate/object index over the triple set at all times.

Three node-keyed index maps (NodesToIndices) hold, for every subject/predicate/object node, an IndexList of the triple indices that mention it. Three parallel reverse-index arrays (sReverseIndices, pReverseIndices, oReverseIndices) store, for every triple slot, its position inside the corresponding IndexList; this is what makes O(1) removal possible.

A triple's reverse-index slot is only meaningful for the (s,p,o) component the triple actually has; readers must always validate via the indicesLarger[posLarger] == tripleIndex cross-check.

The reverse-index arrays are kept the same length as the underlying keys array of the TripleSet; whenever the triple set grows its keys array, the growReverseIndices hook is invoked to grow the reverse arrays too.

      public EagerStoreStrategy(TripleSet triples, boolean parallel)
      Build a new eager strategy over the given triple set, indexing every triple already present.
      Parameters:
      triples - the canonical triple set
      parallel - if true, build the three indices concurrently; otherwise build them sequentially

    • EagerStoreStrategy

      public EagerStoreStrategy(TripleSet triples)
      Build a new eager strategy and index the triple set sequentially. Equivalent to EagerStoreStrategy(triples, false).
      Parameters:
      triples - the canonical triple set

    • EagerStoreStrategy

      public EagerStoreStrategy(TripleSet triples, EagerStoreStrategy strategyToCopyIndicesFrom)
      Copy constructor that reuses an already-built index. Used when copying an IndexedSetTripleStore whose source already has its eager index built, so that the copy can avoid the cost of rebuilding it.

      The triples parameter must be a copy of the original triple set (the indices reference triple slots by index, so the two sets must have identical layouts).

      Parameters:
      triples - the (already-copied) triple set the new strategy will operate on
      strategyToCopyIndicesFrom - the strategy whose indices should be cloned
